title: Tailwind CSS
description: Learn utility-first CSS with Tailwind CSS framework for rapid UI development.

data.text: **Tailwind CSS** is a utility-first CSS framework. Instead of writing custom CSS, you apply pre-existing utility classes directly in your JSX.

data.title: Install Tailwind
data.code:
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p

data.text: Tailwind is highly customizable. You can extend the default theme, add your brand colors, fonts, and spacing scales in the configuration file.

data.title: tailwind.config.js
Customization
data.text: Customize Tailwind by editing `tailwind.config.js` to add your brand colors, fonts, and spacing.

terms.definition: A single-purpose CSS class like p-4 or text-center.
Styles apply to mobile by default; breakpoint prefixes add larger-screen styles.
Just-in-Time mode generates styles on demand, keeping bundle size small.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Utility-first approach - no custom CSS needed
Dark mode support with dark: prefix
data.takeaway: Tailwind CSS speeds up development with utility classes.
